description: cool temperate rainforest and wet sclerophyll forest
vegetation type: cool temperate rainforest (Nothofagus cunninghamii, Atherosperma moschatum, emergent Eucalyptus regnans) surrounded by wet sclerophyll forest (E. regnans over Acacia melanoxylon)
soil_type: valley-floor sediments including anaerobic mire deposits >=2 m deep
notes: Coordinates printed as 145°52'40", 37°33'28" (2.1.1, p.360); converted to decimal degrees. Site is a ~5-6 m deep valley through which Cumberland Creek (small perennial creek, variable flow) flows; occasional winter snowfall; pools of surface water at some times of year. MAP stated as "~170 cm", MAT "~9.6 °C" (from Steart et al. 2002), annual temperature range "~12.8 °C" -- all approximate. The site straddles two vegetation types (Fig. 1). No location code used in the source; full name used as code. Mesocosm experiment rows have no location (experimental tanks filled with Cumberland Creek sediment).
